# Zynq SDR Course: repository instructions

Follow [AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md), [CONTEXT.md](../CONTEXT.md), and [CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md) for technical constraints, writing rules and checks.

This is a bilingual DSP/FPGA/SDR course that ties reference algorithms to finite-precision and HDL implementations, Zynq/AD936x experiments and reproducible evidence. Work in small, focused changes; don't confuse simulation with hardware measurement, fabricate metrics or alter unrelated files. Public changes and PR descriptions should be in English, and commits must not include AI co-authorship. Explain what you changed, how you tested it and what remains unverified.
